program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((comps (sort (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 6)) (objects g 0))
                      (lambda (a b)
                        (if (= (obj-size a) (obj-size b))
                            (let ((ba (obj-bbox a)) (bb (obj-bbox b)))
                              (or (< (first ba) (first bb))
                                  (and (= (first ba) (first bb)) (< (second ba) (second bb)))))
                            (> (obj-size a) (obj-size b))))))
         (obj (second comps))
         (cells (normalize-cells (obj-cells obj))))
    (paint-cells (empty-grid (obj-h obj) (obj-w obj) 0) cells 2)))
